### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – October 13, 2026

#### Hotfix Update

This is a hotfix update. Replay codes from the October 6 patch are still available.

#### Hero Updates

![Doctrine](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/OOz6/256X256/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-33-t.png)

##### Doctrine

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/YaO5/520X128/patch-2026-10-14-efaef24244-02-t.png)

Eternal Scepter

* Damage and healing reduced from 60 to 55.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/WUK0/128X128/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-34-t.png)

Invigorating Drones

* Duration reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.

![Sombra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Fc7j/256X256/4fa20d93cb1de8fcee163484d5dbd5ec1dd04d234019eaf4b7c159d3a62be64a-t.png)

##### Sombra

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Fa7o/253X128/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-08-t.png)

Machine Pistol

* Damage reduced from 7 to 6.5.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/JVj8/128X128/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-13-t.png)

Cyberspace

* Explosion damage reduced from 40 to 20.
* Cooldown increased from 12 to 13 seconds.

![Roadhog](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/KCsJ/256X256/b8afaed1ce60cbddfc555d778839d4670868537a4319814da4ba13cdd1159887-t.png)

##### Roadhog

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/XTdt/212X128/d48d0b264d765e3732abda784e986595f7a6c5ad0e56f1929c008ffc0492a39d-t.png)

Scrap Gun

* Center projectile damage increased from 34 to 40.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/g2tj/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-34-t.png)

Take a Breather

* Cooldown reduced from 2 to 1.25 seconds.
* Damage reduction increased from 35% to 40%.
* Max duration increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds.

![Kiriko](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)

##### Kiriko

* Base health increased from 225 to 250.

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/xXRg/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-01-t.png)

##### D.Mon

* Base armor reduced from 275 to 250.

### 《守望先锋》补丁说明 – 2026年10月14日

#### 不停机更新

这是一次不停机更新。10月7日补丁的回放代码依然有效。

#### 英雄更新

![血律](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/OOz6/256X256/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-33-t.png)

##### 血律

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/YaO5/520X128/patch-2026-10-14-efaef24244-02-t.png)

永恒权杖

* 伤害和治疗量从60降低至55。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/WUK0/128X128/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-34-t.png)

振奋无人机

* 持续时间从6秒缩短至5秒。

![黑影](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Fc7j/256X256/4fa20d93cb1de8fcee163484d5dbd5ec1dd04d234019eaf4b7c159d3a62be64a-t.png)

自动手枪

* 伤害从7降低至6.5。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/JVj8/128X128/patch-2026-10-07-a234d4f0c0-13-t.png)

赛博空间

* 爆炸伤害从40降低至20。
* 冷却时间从12秒增加至13秒。

![路霸](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/KCsJ/256X256/b8afaed1ce60cbddfc555d778839d4670868537a4319814da4ba13cdd1159887-t.png)

##### 路霸

![雾子](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)
